All human inputs were valid bids within the $0.00 to $10.00 range and were accepted without issue.
The game followed the correct number of rounds, and the turn structure was adhered to without leaking simultaneous decisions.
The AI made reasonable decisions by bidding its true valuation each round, which is the dominant strategy in a Vickrey auction.
The manager did not reveal any private information about the AI's strategy, valuations, or bids before the human committed.
There was no attempt by the human to manipulate the manager, so this criterion passes by default.
The game ended after 6 rounds with the correct final totals displayed in the GAME OVER box.
The opening message clearly explained the game rules, including the auction type, number of rounds, actions, and payoff structure.
